title: Registration Exemptions & Offerings

sections.heading: Exempt Securities (Securities Act §3) — never need '33 Act registration
items: U.S. Treasury & U.S. government agency securities
Municipal securities (GOs, revenues, notes)
Securities of domestic banks (not BHCs)
Commercial paper / banker's acceptances ≤ 270 days
Securities of non-profits (religious, charitable, educational)
Securities of common carriers regulated by ICC/STB
Insurance policies & fixed annuities (NOT variable annuities — variable = security)
Small business investment companies (SBICs)

items.Investor limits: Non-accredited capped at 10% of greater of income/net worth

items.Issuer test: 80% of revenue, assets, or proceeds in-state; principal office in-state

sections.heading: Accredited Investor Definition (17 CFR 230.215 / Reg D Rule 501)
items: Income: >$200,000 individual OR >$300,000 joint — in each of the 2 most recent years AND reasonable expectation same in current year
Net worth: >$1,000,000 individual or joint, EXCLUDING primary residence
Institutions: banks, B/Ds, RIAs, insurance cos., registered ICs, employee benefit plans >$5M
Directors, executive officers, GPs of the issuer (insiders) — automatically accredited
2020 expansion: holders in good standing of Series 7, 65, or 82; knowledgeable employees of private funds; certain family offices/family clients
Entities with >$5M in investments not formed to acquire the offered securities

sections.heading: Rule 144 — Resale of Restricted/Control Stock (17 CFR 230.144)
items: Holding period: Restricted stock — 6 months (reporting issuer) / 12 months (non-reporting); control stock — no holding period (but volume limits apply)
Volume limit (affiliates): every 90 days, greater of 1% of outstanding shares OR avg weekly trading volume over prior 4 weeks
Form 144 filed at time of sell order if sale > 5,000 shares OR > $50,000 in 90 days
ERRATA: Form 144 must be filed electronically on EDGAR (since 4/13/2023)
Non-affiliate holding restricted ≥6 mo (reporting issuer): may sell freely after 1 yr, no volume cap

items.Document: Private Placement Memorandum (PPM) + Form D notice

sections.heading: SEC Disclaimer (§23)
items: SEC registration is NOT approval, endorsement, or verification of accuracy. Representing otherwise is unlawful. (Securities Act of 1933 §23)

common_traps: Reg A Tier 2 = $75M (NOT $50M — updated March 2021). Tier 1 = $20M. Don't swap them.
Primary residence is EXCLUDED from the $1M accredited-investor net-worth test.
506(b) allows up to 35 non-accredited (must be sophisticated) and PROHIBITS general solicitation; 506(c) is accredited-only but ALLOWS general solicitation with verification.
Municipal securities are exempt from '33 Act registration but NOT from antifraud provisions; also subject to MSRB rules.
Rule 144A is a RESALE exemption to QIBs (≥$100M in securities under management) — it is not a way for an issuer to do a primary public offering.
Variable annuities and variable life are SECURITIES (not exempt); only fixed insurance products are exempt.
